name: Dusty Server Rack
examine: An old rack wheezing out hash. Mostly fan noise.

depleted.name: Overheated Rack
depleted.examine: Too hot to mine. It needs a moment and a fan.

name: Humming Server Rack
examine: It hums in the key of 'number go up'.

depleted.name: Overheated Rack
depleted.examine: Too hot to mine. It needs a moment and a fan.

name: Liquid-Cooled Rack
examine: Kept in the west wing. Bubbles like a premium aquarium.

depleted.name: Overheated Rack
depleted.examine: Too hot to mine. It needs a moment and a fan.

name: Rubber Chicken Dinner
examine: Donors, rubber chicken, and rumors.

depleted.name: Empty Table
depleted.examine: The donors went home. More are on the way.

name: Gala Table
examine: Black tie. Black secrets.

depleted.name: Empty Table
depleted.examine: The donors went home. More are on the way.

name: Yacht Party Deck
examine: Where the really big donors float their ideas.

depleted.name: Empty Table
depleted.examine: The donors went home. More are on the way.

name: Junior Lobbyist
examine: Eager. Underpaid. Paying you anyway.

depleted.name: Busy Lobbyist
depleted.examine: On the phone. Try again in a moment.

name: K Street Veteran
examine: Has seen eleven administrations. Pays well.

depleted.name: Busy Lobbyist
depleted.examine: On the phone. Try again in a moment.

name: Shadow Broker
examine: Nobody knows who he works for. The money is real. Suspiciously fresh, but real.

depleted.name: Busy Lobbyist
depleted.examine: On the phone. Try again in a moment.

name: Press Podium
examine: Raw scandals go in. Talking Points come out.

name: Bank Booth
examine: The Treasury's bank. Your deposits are safe, and definitely not a con.

name: Trading Terminal
examine: Fixed prices, paid in Tickets. The Bureau hates a price it can't print.

name: Bunker Hatch
examine: A heavy hatch in the floor. It leads to a bunker.

name: Ladder
examine: Back up to the Treasury.

name: Trench Entrance
examine: Sandbags, mud, and something growling. The Trenches.

name: Supply Ladder
examine: Back to the Treasury lawn.

name: Barricade
examine: It opens for whoever beats the boss guarding it.

name: RoadMap to $100bn
examine: RoadMap to $100bn (+ ∞%). It has one step. The step is an arrow.

name: Marble Pillar
examine: Holds up the Treasury. Somebody has to. It doesn't stop at the floor; it keeps going down, under the mud.

name: Flagpole
examine: The flag of The People's Bitcoin. It only goes up.

name: Park Bench
examine: Reserved for people waiting for the price target.

name: Gremlin Fountain
examine: A golden Gremlin, older than the Treasury. Someone has scratched 'FREE ME' on the base. Its water has never frozen and never boiled.

name: Swamp Oak
examine: A sturdy tree. Good shade for lobbyists.

name: Storage Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

name: Med Bay Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

name: Terminal Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

name: Bed Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

builds.name: Respawn Bed
builds.examine: If you fall in battle, you wake up here instead of the Treasury.

name: Server Farm Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

builds.name: Server Farm I
builds.examine: Mines Scrap Hash while you are busy elsewhere.

builds.name: Server Farm II
builds.examine: Mines Warm Hash while you are busy elsewhere.

builds.name: Server Farm III
builds.examine: Mines Molten Hash while you are busy elsewhere.

name: Armory Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

builds.name: Armory
builds.examine: Fills with lots of Rounds over time.

name: Circle Space
examine: An empty spot in your bunker. Something useful could go here.

name: Teleport Chamber
examine: Built long before the Lockdown, by someone who didn't use bolts. Abandoned after. It hums very, very quietly.

name: Return Chamber
examine: The way back to the Treasury. It works both ways.

name: Signpost
examine: WELCOME TO THE WORLD OUT THERE. Population: you. West: the Sproto Ranch. East: the Hatchery. Everything past this hill: unexplored.

name: Expedition Sign
examine: Painted on the first day of the Lockdown: EXPEDITION ONE, NORTH OR BUST. Someone has underlined BUST.

name: Expedition Crate
examine: Stenciled EXPEDITION ONE. Inside: empty Hopium cans and a list of twelve names. Ten are crossed out. Not the Captain. Not Scout Greenhill.

name: Tally Board
examine: Scout Greenhill's calendar: four hundred and twelve tally marks. The newest one is fresh.

name: Wrong-Namer Placard
examine: THERE IS NO OUTSIDE. GO HOME. On the back, in tiny letters: 'what if there is though'.

name: Abandoned Pack
examine: Left on the duckboards with a note: 'If you find this, I went back. Sorry, Captain.'

name: Keep Moving Sign
examine: Painted, then repainted, then repainted again. The mud around it is worn into a perfect loop.

name: Old Treasury Sign
examine: TELEPORT CHAMBER: OUT OF SERVICE. Someone has scratched out OUT OF.

name: Kundalina's Stall
examine: Staffs, hats, robes and crates of COOM, priced in Tickets.

name: Rowboat
examine: A note is pinned to the seat: 'TO THE ACADEMY. ROW YOURSELF.'

name: Rowboat
examine: Back across the lake to The World Out There.

name: Bookshelf
examine: Spellbooks: 'Hexes for Bear Markets', 'Charms for the Long Hold', 'One Weird Cantrip'.

name: Cauldron
examine: Something green bubbles inside. It smells like ambition.

name: Crystal Ball
examine: You see a candle chart. It only goes up. Then you blink and it's a crystal ball again.

name: Dining Table
examine: Set for a feast nobody has eaten since the Rugmancer took the gold.

name: Academy Sign
examine: MOONWARD ACADEMY OF APPLIED WIZARDRY. Students: no duelling in the halls. Or the library. Or near the lake.

name: Turret
examine: A pointed tower roof. The academy has a lot of these. Wizards like pointy things. So did whoever built them, for reasons involving the air.

name: The Great Rug
examine: The academy's whole endowment, woven into one magnificent rug. It's worth more than the tower it's lying in.

name: Treasury Gates
examine: Sealed since the Bureau forecast a crash. A brass plate reads: THE LOCKDOWN ACT. SECTION ONE: THE GATES STAY SHUT. Nobody remembers voting for it. The plate is stamped 'BUREAU'.

name: Dirt Trail
examine: A muddy trail heading west. Hoofprints, bootprints, and a lot of very small blue footprints.

name: Hatchery Road
examine: A paved road heading east. Someone has painted 'EVERY COIN PAIRED' on every tenth stone.

name: Trail Back
examine: Back to The World Out There and the Return Chamber.

name: Broadcast Camera
examine: The Sproto Ranch Show camera. The red light is always on. Somebody has taped over the Bureau's backdoor port.

name: Corral Stone
examine: An old cornerstone poking out of the corral mud, carved with stars. The Sprotos sleep on it, and it glows when they do.

name: Ranch Sign
examine: THE SPROTO RANCH. Live every Sunday. Hats mandatory. Bears not invited.

name: Tartarian Incubator
examine: A warm stone egg-cradle with no power cable. Every coin hatched in it comes out paired with Tickets.

name: Hatchery Board
examine: THE HATCHERY. Every coin paired with Tickets. Fees stay on the ground. No extraction. (This means you.)

name: Grey Memo
examine: BUREAU OF MONETARY WEATHER. INTERNAL. To: the Treasurer. Re: the Reserve. DUMP TICKETS. BUY THE PRINTABLE ONE. Tickets cannot be printed, inflated or forecast, and the Client Upstairs finds them 'indigestible'. Burn after reading. (Underneath, in Treasurer Bickworth's handwriting: 'which way up is this?')

name: Gala Seating Chart
examine: TABLE 1: Donors. TABLE 2: Lobbyists. TABLE 3: Mr. Grey, and Mr. Grey (+1). DIETARY NOTES: Mr. Grey requires no food, only 'a reading of the inflation figures'. Do not seat near Sprotos. Do not seat near windows. Do NOT, under any circumstances, ask about the ears.

name: Lobbyist Receipt No. 0001
examine: SHADOW BROKERAGE, K STREET. Item: one (1) Lockdown Act, pre-drafted. Item: twelve (12) megaphones, Wrong-Namer grade. Item: two (2) grey suits, field use. Paid in full, in fresh notes (still warm). Received: S. Broker. Deliver to: the Elevator, top floor. (There is no top floor.)

name: Lockdown Act, Draft 3 (Redacted)
examine: SECTION ONE: THE GATES STAY SHUT. SECTION TWO: THERE IS NO ████████. SECTION THREE: Should the Treasury hold Tickets, a crash shall be forecast and nobody shall leave until the Tickets are ████. DRAFTED BY: the Bureau of Monetary Weather, on behalf of ███ ██████ ████████. VOTES CAST: 0.

name: Printer Log, Page 1
examine: BRRR-LOG v1. 03:33 PRINT 1,000,000 notes. DESTINATION: UP. 03:33 PRINT 1,000,000 notes. DESTINATION: UP. 03:34 PRINT 1 Ticket. ERROR: TICKETS ARE A FIXED COUNT. ERROR: SPROTO DETECTED NEAR COUNT. 03:34 RETRY. ERROR. 03:35 NOTIFY BUREAU.

name: Expedition One Field Note
examine: Day 1. The map-reader says the old map has a star drawn at the north end of the wall. Five points. 'Like a fort,' he says. The Captain says we dig. Day 4. Black sludge that smells like a print shop. Day 6. Two men in grey suits on the duckboards. Nobody saw them come down the ladder.

name: Wrong-Namer Script (Bureau Issue)
examine: SHOUT, IN ORDER: 1. 'THERE IS NO OUTSIDE.' 2. 'IT'S ALL TRICKETS.' 3. 'STOP LOOKING AT DOMES.' IF ASKED WHO PRINTS THE MONEY: shout louder. IF ASKED WHO WROTE THIS SCRIPT: see 3. Replacement megaphones from: Bureau of Monetary Weather, Dept. of Public Mood.

name: Captain's Orders (Grey Ink)
examine: TO: Captain, Expedition One. The Chamber is DECOMMISSIONED BY ORDER. Should any person see it working, the old Tartarian roads reopen, Tickets flow outward, and there will be severe consequences for the money supply. Keep moving. Momentum is everything. Do not stop. Do not look. (Signed: B.M.W., Field Office.)

name: Tartarian Tablet I: The Count
examine: Carved deep into old marble: WE MADE ONE BILLION TICKETS OF PASSAGE, AND NEVER ONE MORE. NO PRESS SHALL STRIKE THEM. NO FIRE SHALL MELT THEM. LET THE SMALL BLUE KEEPERS HOLD THE COUNT, FOR WHAT CANNOT BE PRINTED CANNOT BE STOLEN BY THOSE WHO PRINT. (The little carved figure at the bottom looks a lot like a Sproto.)

name: Weather Balloon Report
examine: BUREAU OF MONETARY WEATHER. PUBLIC STATEMENT. The 'domes' seen from this hill are weather balloons. The 'star-shaped walls' are weather balloons. The 'towers that drink power from the air' are, as this Bureau's name suggests, weather. Please return to your Treasury. Forecast: inflation, with scattered printing.

name: Tartarian Tablet II: The Spires
examine: THE SPIRES DRINK THE SKY, AND THE SKY ASKS NOTHING BACK. WHOEVER OWNS FREE POWER NEED NOT OWN A PRESS. THEREFORE THE PRESS-OWNERS WILL COME FOR THE SPIRES. HIDE THE TICKETS. TEACH THE CHILDREN TO CALL IT MAGIC, SO THAT NOBODY THINKS TO PATENT IT.

name: Bursar's Ledger (Torn Page)
examine: ENDOWMENT DISBURSEMENTS. One third to the Bureau of Monetary Weather ('forecasting fees'). One third to the Shadow Brokerage ('access'). One third to coordinates 0°, 0°, altitude 'yes'. Memo line: 'For the Client Upstairs. Converted to the printable currency first, as requested. They will not touch Tickets.'

name: Sproto Power Fragment
examine: Scratched into a feeding trough, in very small handwriting: A SPROTO CANNOT BE PRINTED. A SPROTO CANNOT BE FAKED. A SPROTO GLOWS ON OLD STONE AND BITES WHOEVER CARRIES A GREY ENVELOPE. THE EGREGORE MADE US TO KEEP THE COUNT. ONE BILLION. WE CHECKED. TWICE.

name: Field Order: Operation GRIZZ
examine: BUREAU FIELD OFFICE. Subject: MORELIGHT (broadcaster, mustache). Problem: tells the public, live on Sundays, who prints the money. Solution: one (1) bear, standard issue, zip at rear. Headline pre-approved: 'RIP MORELIGHT THE GRIZZ BEAR EATED HIM.' If the public says FAKE NEWS: ████████████.

name: Tartarian Tablet III: The Hatching
examine: WHEN THE PRESS-OWNERS RULE THE MARKETS, BUILD A NEST. LET EVERY NEW COIN BE BORN BESIDE A TICKET, SO THAT EVERY TRADE FEEDS THE COUNT AND NOT THE SKY. THE EGGS WILL STAY WARM WITHOUT FIRE. THE GREY ONES WILL COME TO SKIM. THEY ALWAYS COME TO SKIM.

name: Extractor's Invoice
examine: PUMP & DUMP LAUNCH SERVICES (ORBITAL) LTD. Bill to: Every New Coin. Platform cost: 100%. Payable to: the Client Upstairs, c/o the Upper Ledger. NOTE: Hatchery coins pair with Tickets and pay us nothing. Escalate to the Printer. Subcontractor on file: 'The Floret Lord' (bundling, sniping, vibes).

name: Bundler's Wallet Map
examine: Two hundred wallets, each drawn as a tiny broccoli. Notes: 'Snipe block 0. Bundle 80%. Stream the organic pump. Dump on chat.' Signed with a vape-cloud doodle: THE FLORET LORD, LA. In the corner: 'Hatchery won't let me bundle, it pairs everything with Tickets. Tell the grey guy.'

name: Printer Log, Final Page
examine: BRRR-LOG, LAST ENTRY. Total printed: all of it. Destination: UP, to the Upper Ledger, where the Client feeds on inflation the way you feed on toast. Total Tickets printed: 0. Reason: cannot. Reason for the reason: Sprotos. Bureau recommendation: lock the Treasury. Printer recommendation: PANIC. Status: the Treasury is open.
